text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ho-ou and {0} had come from Gio Gehenna to a farming village near Landosol for a certain reason
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホウオウと{0}は、
とある理由で
ジオ・ゲヘナからランドソル近くの農村にやってきたのだが──

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: UWWWWEEEHHHHHHHH?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひええええええ～～～！！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: SIC 'EMMMMMMM!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 死にさらせええええええっっ！！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: WHY! WHY IS THIS HAPPENING TO MEEEEE?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どぼぢでぇ～
どぼぢて私がこんな目にぃぃぃぃ！？

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: You MORONS! Just where did it run off to... that accursed chicken drumstick?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダラズがぁ！　
どこに逃げよった
あのぼんじり！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 2
text_block_list.text: Nay, 'tis a chicken wing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いんや、
手羽先だ！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: Chicken breast!
text_block_list.orig_text: やげんなんこォつ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Uuuu. Me, a God, being referred to by using the edible parts of a chicken... how disrespectful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううううう。
神たる私を
ニワトリの可食部名称で呼ぶとは、
なんたる不敬……っ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Or rather! I was supposed to be enjoying delicious rice in a rural area in this world... so how did things even get to this point?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
というか！
こちらの世界の農村でおいしいお米をいただくはずが、
どうしてこんなことになるんですかぁぁぁ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: To answer that, let's dial the story back to yesterday, in Gio Teogonia...
text_block_list.orig_text:
話は昨日、
ジオ・テオゴニアでの出来事にさかのぼる──

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Mumumuuuu... Kehee... It seems like I'm still unable to take my human form back... Even though Pecorine-san helped me get back some of my authority...
text_block_list.orig_text:
むむむ……
はぁ。
やはり、
人間の姿になれないようです……
ペコリーヌさんが、
権能の一部を取り返してきてくれたというのに……

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: That enormous robotic doll... G-Gigantic...? It seems like I used up all of my power just to bring over that version of Croce-san. I don't really have a problem with that, but... Geez!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの大変巨大なお人形……
ぎ、
ぎがんちっく？
なクローチェさんを運ぶのに力を使い果たしてしまったらしくて。
言葉を話すくらいは問題ないのですが……、
もうっ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Although I am a majestic, graceful, and dependable God, I cannot tolerate this kind of trouble that always comes my way! I shall never be fooled anew by the words of a human child!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくら私が荘厳かつ優美で頼りがいのある神だからといって、
厄介ごとばかり持ち込まれては困ります！
もう二度と人の子の口車には乗りませんからね！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: And here you go acting all in high spirits again... Ahem. Well, if that's another way to say you're going to present an offering, I'll respectfully accept it. ...I'm hungry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
またあなたは、
言ったそばから調子のいいことを……
コホン。
まぁ、
供物を捧げたいというなら
謹んで受け取りましょう。
お腹空きましたし。

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Let's see... the sweetness of Gio Teogonia isn't bad, but I'd rather have a meal that fills me up more... Ah, I know, rice! Rice would be best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですねえ……
ジオ・テオゴニアの甘味も悪くないのですが
どうせなら
もっとお腹にたまる食事……
そうです、
お米！　
お米がいいです！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: The rice that Mahiru-san treated me to a while ago came to mind. That was quite something. ...Not that I’ve come to terms with being treated like poultry, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
以前、
マヒルさんにごちそうになったお米。
あれはなかなかのものですね。
……
ニワトリ扱いされたのは納得いきませんが。

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Good deeds come to those who hurry. That's a commendable attitude♪ I shall grant you the right to carry me upon your shoulders, Kishi-san! Piyo-piyo~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
善は急げというわけですね。
良い心がけです♪
では騎士さんに、
私を肩に乗せて歩く権利を与えます！
ぴよぴよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: What a quiet and peaceful place you've brought me to. The fields are laden with golden rice... Hehehe, it's almost as if they were waiting for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なかなかのどかで良いところですね。
田んぼに黄金色の稲がたわわに実って……
ふふふ、
まるで私を待っていたかのようではありませんか！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: I... I’ll even eat it raw if I have to!! Let's ask that farmer over there for some rice right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もう生米でもかまいません！
さっそく
そこの農民さんに米を分けてもらいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuh? What's yer deal, lad?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あぁん？　
なんだべおめえさん？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: I am Ho-ou. A sacred bird akin to a God! I shall grant you the right to offer some rice to me as an offering! Let this be an honor to~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
ホウオウ。
偉大なる神の鳥です！
あなたたちに、
私にお米を捧げる権利をあげましょう！
光栄に思──……

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: Yer... a damn pest bird! Ye've come to prey on the rice we've worked so hard to grow! Everyone! It's a pest bird! C'mere, fast!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こぉんの
害鳥が！
せっかく育てた稲を
狙いにきよったか！
皆の衆！　
害鳥だー！　
であえであえ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Pe-pe-pe... Pest bird!? H-Hmph, that's beyond disrespectful! Can't you see these beautiful, untarnished feathers? Those are a God's... EEEK! NOT THE HOE! STOP IT!
text_block_list.orig_text:
がががが
害鳥？　
ふっ
不敬にもほどがありますよ！
この汚れを知らぬ美しい羽毛が見えないのですか？
これは神たる……
キャー！　
鍬は！　
鍬はやめてぇぇ！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: What's that? That ain't no sparrow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだべ？　
すずめじゃなかったんだべか！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 2
text_block_list.text: Since yer were staring longingly at our rice plantation, I thought yer were some kind of pest bird.
text_block_list.orig_text:
物ほしそうに
オラたちの稲ば見てっから、
てっきり害鳥のたぐいかと。

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: I-I wasn't staring at anything! T-Though it is true that I'm hungry right now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな目はしてませんよぅ～！
た、
確かに
ちょっぴりお腹は空いていますが……

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: If that's yer issue, why not say it earlier? We've got plenty of delicious white rice! Here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それならそうと早く言ってくんろ？
白飯ならたぁ～んとあっから！　
ほぉれ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Uwaah, a mountainbowl of white rice all for me...! Ahem. As long as you understand, that's fine! All right. I, Ho-ou, shall accept your humble offering!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわ、
お茶碗に山盛りの白ごはん……！
コホン。
わかればよいのです！　
よろしいっ。
その供物、
このホウオウが平らげてあげます！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Mmm, the sweetness of this rice! Newly harvested! Freshly cooked! I'm so happy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もぐもぐ……
んんん、
この米の甘み！
新米！　
炊き立て！　
しあわせですぅ～！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: Ye can eat a lot. Lots more. As much as ye'd want.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさんお食べ。
もっとお食べ。
よぉくかんでお食べ。

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch* Ah, yet another new meal... *munch, munch* ...T-That will be it. Not only am I full, my throat's also filled...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んぐんぐ、
あっ、
また新しいご飯が……
もぐもぐ、
はぐはぐ。
……
も、
もう入りません。
お腹いっぱいどころか
喉いっぱい……

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: Ah, what's that, yer full already? Hyo-hyo... Well then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁんだもう満腹かね？
ヒョッ
ヒョッ
ヒョッ……
それじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1 Farmer 2 Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: SIC 'EMMMMMMMM!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 死にさらせぇぇぇぇぇぇぇっ！！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: NGUGUGUGGUUUUHHHHH!? WH-WH-WHY IS THIS HAPPENING!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んぐぐっ！？
ななな、
なぜっ、
どうぢで
ま゛だぁ゛ぁ゛～！？

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: Heheheh... yer stuffed to the brim... That rice stuck halfway through yer belly must be soaked in some delicious broth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ククク……
ぱんっ
ぱんに詰め込みおって……
その腹んなかば米、
さぞいいダシが染みとるじゃろうて！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text:
It might be from a land farther away than Oedo, but... If we offer those monsters Samgyetang I'm sure they'll be happy! 
( TLNote: Korean dish, chicken stuffed with rice )
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーエドよりも彼方の地で食べられとるっちゅー
「さむげぇたん」なら、
きっとあの魔物も満足してくれるべ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: NNNNGH! D-Don't strangle me like that! Oh no! Rice is coming out of my mouth!? Ororooo *barfs*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん゛っ゛！
ぞ、
ぞんなに首を絞められるとっ！　
だめ゛っ゛！
口からお米がっっ！？　
おろろ～っ……

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: Wha-... What's that? A mysterious white liquid is coming out of that pest bird's mouth...! 'Tis g-glistening...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんっ、
なんだぁ？
あの害鳥さの口から、
謎の白い液体が……！
キ、
キラキラしとるべ……！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why would you go and collect it?! Huh? Ah... I-It's certainly true that if we wasted food, its producers would be mad at us. No, actually, those same producers almost killed me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんで受け止めるんですか！？　
えっ？　
あっ……
た、
確かに食べ物を粗末にしたら生産者の方に怒られますね。
ていうか、
殺されかけましたけど。

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Wha... Eeehhhh? Although it's wrong to waste food, that's a bit...! Y-You should use that bucket over there----... Ugh, ororororo *barfs*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ……
えええっ？　
食べ物を粗末にするのはいけないとはいえ
さすがにそれは……っ！　
そ、
そこのバケツ使っ──
……
うぷっ、
おろろ～っ……

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, h-huh? Am I back to my human form? Because I ate that rice?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
あ、
あれ？　
私、
人間の姿に戻ってる？
お米食べたおかげ？

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh... it's a lass! So ye weren't a pest bird?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお……
娘っ子の姿に！
害鳥じゃなかったんだべか！？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: That's what I've been telling you this entire timeeee!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: だから何度もそう言っているじゃないですかああああ！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: Curses, our bad... We might've been clueless, but yer making me realize we did something bad.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
すまねぇな……
知らねぇこととはいえ、
悪いことしただよ。

text_block_list.name: Farmer 2
text_block_list.text: Y'see, a strange monster has been destroying our fields recently, and it's causing trouble. Yet it always leaves when I offer it some rice dishes... Which is why we wanted to offer ye...
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は最近、
おかしな魔物が
田畑を荒らして困っとるんじゃ。
いつも
うまい米料理を捧げると
帰ってもらえるんでよ、
その
供物をと……

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: I-I'm the higher being who's supposed to be receiving offerings, and yet here you are trying to cook me into a Samgyetang and offer me to some lowly being...! And what's the deal with that gluttonous monster, anyway?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
く、
供物を受け取る側である私を
「さむげぇたん」とやらに
調理して捧げようとするなんて！
それにいったいなんなのですか、
その食いしんぼうな魔物は！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: Th-Those footsteps... Speak of the devil! It's that thing! It's here!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こんの足音は……
噂をすれば、だべ！
ヤツだべ！　
ヤツが来たべ！！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: That thing...? That's...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やつって、
あれは……！

text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Isn't that... a cursed spirit?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれは……
祟り神ではありませんか！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: They are beings like gods or spirits who have lost their powers and became beasts without reason, just like I used to be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
精霊や神々が力を失ったことにより、
理性のないけだものとなってしまった存在です。
いわば、
かつての私と同じ。

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: You and the others saved me, Kishi-san, but... if you had made one wrong move...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は騎士さんたちに助けられましたが、
一歩間違えば……

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Kishi-san, so you're thinking what I am? Heh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さんも
そう思いますか？
……

text_block_list.name: Farmer 2
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah, everything's all over! That Samgyetang was a flop, and I have no idea what to offer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああああ、
もうおしまいだぁ～！
「さむげぇたん」もアテが外れて、
なーんの料理もねえ！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: We've given it sushi, risotto, fried rice... even biryani! I've got no more idea for any rice dish! And this darn glutton won't go back and eat something it already tasted before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
寿司もリゾットもチャーハンも
ビリヤニも食わせた！
もう米料理なんてなんも思いつかねえだ！
あんの食いしん坊、
一度食った料理には見向きもしねえだよッ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. In that case, leave this to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よろしい。
そういうことでしたら、
この私に任せてもらいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: As a fellow God, I cannot overlook this! Let's feed it delicious rice dishes and help it regain its strength like I did!
text_block_list.orig_text:
同じ神として、
見過ごすことはできません！
おいしいお米料理を食べさせて、
この私のように
力を取り戻してもらおうではありませんか！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: Lassie, ye can cook?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おめえさん、
料理なんか作れるのけ？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: As a Goddess, nothing is beyond me! Witness a recipe I learned from a certain chef with a rolling tongue a long time ago! It had an indescribable taste, but it was absolutely delicious~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
神たる私に
不可能などありませーん！
昔、
とある巻き舌の料理人から教わったレシピを披露しましょう！
あれは得も言われぬ味、
大変に美味でした～♪

text_block_list.name: Cursed Spirit ( Tatarigami )
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Ah, look! Just my beautiful words caused that cursed spirit to react! As expected from myself! My food review was perfect! Ehem♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ほら！　
私の美麗なトークだけで祟り神が反応しましたよ！
さっすが私！　
食レポも完璧！　
えっへん♪

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: Not really... that monster's staring at yer bucket over there, ain't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いんや、
あの魔物が見とるのは……
そこのバケツでねえか？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Huh? What bucket? You mean the one with the rice I just kinda... spit up??
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
バケツ？　
さっき私が口に含んだ米が何か？

text_block_list.name: Cursed Spirit ( Tatarigami )
text_block_list.text: Guooooooooonnh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオオオオオオンッッ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: EEEKKKKKK?! S-Such a thing! D-DON'T DRINK THAT!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいぃぃっ！？　
そ、
そんなもの、
飲んじゃだめですぅぅぅ！

text_block_list.name: Cursed Spirit ( Tatarigami )
text_block_list.text: *gulp gulp*!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ゴクゴクゴクッッ！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 2
text_block_list.text: O-Ohhh... That monster's... enveloped by some kind of divine light!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おおお……
魔物が、
神々しい光に包まれとるぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: Up until now, it's only reacted to rice dishes, so why? ...Huh?! I-It can't be?! Is that beauty sake?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今まで米料理にしか反応しなかったくせに、
なんでまた？
……はっ！？　
ま、
まさか！？　
美人酒か！？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: B-Beauty sake? It's true that I am a beautiful and noble being, but... What is that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
び、
美人酒？　
確かに私は美しく高貴な存在ですが……
なんです、
それ？

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: Beauty sake is also known as mouth-chewed sake, which is made by women chewing rice in their mouths and sugaring it with their saliva! Then it ferments in a bucket and...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
美人酒は、
別名口噛み酒っちゅーてな
おなごが口の中で米を
はぐはぐして、
唾液で
糖化させて作るんじゃあ！
それがバケツの中で発酵して……！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: Now I see! Sake made from rice is also a rice dish! That was a blind spot for me! What a low blow...! Lassie, yer imagination when it comes to food is no joke!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言われてみれば、
米で作った酒も、
米料理の一つ！
も、
盲点じゃった！　
ワシらとしたことが……！
その食に対する発想力、
アンタただものでねえな！？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: B-Being praised for that... is nothing to be proud of...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こんな感心のされかた……
うれしくない……

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: Umm, well... that over there is something I threw up, you know? I already thought it was strange when Pecorine-san gulped down the hot spring water I was in and said it tasted like soup, but this goes even beyond that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの～、
だってあれ、
私が
戻しちゃったやつですよ？
ペコリーヌさんが、
私が浸かった温泉水が
スープみたい
って
ガブ飲みしたときもどうかと思いましたが、
それを上回りますよ？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: B-Being called a "beauty" to assert that I'm one... that doesn't really dissatisfy me♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな
美人
美人
といわれると……
わっ、
悪い気はしませんけれどっ♪

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing... That accursed monster was entirely purified and ascended to the heavens...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
す、
すげえ……
あの凶悪な魔物が
キラ
キラ浄化されて、
昇天しちまった……！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: Not only that, all the surrounding rice fields are now sparkling... Could that monster be some kind of rice God?! It must be the one who governs the fertility of rice crops!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それどころか、
あたりの田んぼ全部がキラキラに……
ひょっとして、
米の精霊様だったんじゃねえだか！？
稲作の豊穣を司る神さんだべ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: C-C’mon, now! It was just as I said, wasn't it? If we had just exterminated it, the crops wouldn’t have grown in this land anymore. See? Aren't I great? Me? Praise me more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
ほらほら！　
私が言った通りだったでしょう？
あのまま退治してたら
もうこの地に作物は実らなかったですよ？
ねえ？　
偉大ですよね
私？　
そこの部分をもっとたたえなさい！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 2
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, it's great...! This mouth-chewed sake is simply... DIVINE! 'Tis great gluttony that has brought about this result!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
偉大じゃ……！　
偉大すぎる、
口噛み酒！
偉大なる食い意地が
この結果をもたらしたんじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: This is no mere mouth-chewed sake any longer! 'Tis a legendary ELIXIR! The sake has evolved into a mouth-chewed ELIXIR!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただの口噛み酒じゃこうはいかねえだ！
もはや
伝説の
エリクサー！　
口噛みエリクサーの域に達してるだ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: N-No, as I said, that's not what you should be praising. It should be my keen insight, right? So, m-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いえ、
ですから
褒めるのはそこの部分でなくて。
私の慧眼をですね？　
もっと……

text_block_list.name: Farmer 3
text_block_list.text: WHOOOOOOOOOOOA! GOD OF FOOD! GOURMET GOD!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおおおおおお！　
食神様！　
グルメ神！

text_block_list.name: Farmer 1
text_block_list.text: YO! GOD OF GLUTTONY! Tonight we're FEASTING! I will gratefully accept this ELIXIR! Gourmet God!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっ！　
ゴッド・オブ・食いしん坊！
今宵は宴じゃ！　
このエリクサーありがたくいただきます！
グルメ神様ぁぁぁぁぁ！

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: ...No, um. I'm the Goddess who purified that thing. Um, are you even listening? Hey?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……イエ、
あの。
私、
浄化を司る神なんですけど。
あの、
聞いてます？　
ねえ？

text_block_list.name: Ho-oh
text_block_list.text: ...GEEEEEEEEEEEEZ!!! I DON'T FEEL REFRESHED AT ALLLLLLL!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──もおおおおおお！　
なんかスッキリしないですぅぅぅぅぅぅぅ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, with Ho-ou's special beauty sake, the village was saved...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、
ホウオウ特製の美人酒によって、
村は救われたのであった──
